title: A Hymn for the Choir
author: Yara Vasquez
blurb: Casper Fairweather, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
